description: Root-cause provenance for one finding: the introducing commit from git pickaxe on the finding's content, the current-line commit from git blame, the associated GitHub PR when the API answers, and the finding's ref history from the scan store. Confirmed evidence, inferences, and unestablished items are reported separately; nothing is guessed.

findingId.description: Full findingId (tw_...) or a prefix of at least 8 characters

path.description: Local clone path to run git evidence against (default: the path recorded at ingest)

name: finding_provenance
